name: Warp
author: E. T. Carter
description: A loom's warp — thin bright vertical threads on a near-black field that ripple side to side as a slow sinusoidal wave travels down them, with soft glow nodes blooming where a sweeping horizontal weft crosses, tinted across the palette by thread position.

params.label: Ripple drift
params.effect: Speed the sinusoidal ripple travels down the warp threads; 0 freezes the weave, high sends the wave coursing down at speed.

params.label: Ripple amplitude
params.effect: How far the threads sway side to side; low is a taut straight warp, high billows the weave into deep waves.

params.label: Thread spacing
params.effect: Distance between warp threads in CSS px - dense packed weave at the minimum, open sparse threads at the maximum.

params.label: Thread width
params.effect: Half-width of each thread in CSS px, with its halo scaling alongside - fine hairline filaments to thick glowing cords.

params.label: Glow
params.effect: Overall brightness of the threads and the weft glow nodes; low is a delicate quiet weave, high a luminous neon warp.

params.label: Weft speed
params.effect: Speed the horizontal weft glow bands sweep up and down the warp, lighting nodes where they cross; 0 holds them still.

params.label: Thread randomize
params.effect: Per-thread jitter of position, ripple amplitude, phase, width and brightness; 0 is an even machine-true warp, high frays it into a hand-strung weave of uneven threads.

params.label: Thread slant
params.effect: Shears the whole warp off-vertical; 0 hangs the threads straight up, away from 0 tilts them into a leaning diagonal weave.

params.label: Node bloom
params.effect: Strength of the glow nodes that bloom where the weft crosses the warp; 0 leaves bare threads, high lights brilliant beads at every crossing.
